role: AK_TEXT (lines); MODERN_EDITORIAL (note marks, footnotes not reproduced)
comment: Frame 074, printed p. 58: the demonstration for the right triangle concluded: the square اٮحد is divided into four equal squares; the line from ه to ط cuts the square اك into two triangles, اطه and هكط, whose legs اط and اه are half the sides and whose chord طه stands at a right angle; the lines from ط to ز, from ز to the middle of the lower side and from there to ه make eight equal triangles, four of which are half the great square اد; the square on اط is two triangles, the square on اه two more, together four, and the square on طه also four: what was to be shown. Then «وهذه صورته» and the figure. Below the rule one footnote of the editors.

lines.text: فصار سطح {ov:اٮ} {ov:حد} أربعة سطوح متساوية الأضلاع والزوايا والمساحة وهى
سطح {ov:اك} وسطح {ov:حك} وسطح {ov:ٮك} وسطح {ov:دك} ثم نخرج من نقطة
{ov:ه} الى نقطة ط خطاً يقطع سطح {ov:اك} نصفين فحدث من السطح مثلثان وهما
مثلثا {ov:اطه} و{ov:هكط} فقد تبين لنا أن {ov:اط} نصف {ov:اٮ} و{ov:اه} مثله وهو نصف
{ov:اح} ووترهما خط {ov:طه} على زاوية قائمة وكذلك نخرج خطوطاً من {ov:ط} الى {ov:ز}
ومن {ov:ز} الى {ov:ع} ومن {ov:ع} الى {ov:ه} فيحدث من جميع المربعة ثمانى مثلثات
متساويات وقد تبين لنا أن أربعة منها نصف السطح الأعظم الذى هو {ov:اد} وقد
تبين لنا أن ضلع {ov:اط} فى نفسه تكسير مثلثين ، {ov:اه} {n:١} تكسير مثلثين مثلهما فيكون
جميع ذلك تكسير أربع مثلثات وضلع {ov:هط} فى نفسه أيضاً تكسير أربع مثلثات
أخر وقد تبين لنا أن الذى يكون من ضرب {ov:اط} فى نفسه ، {ov:اه} فى نفسه مجموعين
مثل الذى يكون من ضرب {ov:طه} فى نفسه وذلك ما أردنا أن نبين وهذه صورته .

observations: The letters that label the figure carry a short wavy line above them (here a line above), over one of their letters; the machine reading misreads most of them, as on the earlier frames; the ط after نقطة in L03 is printed without it and is transcribed without it. The ب of the labels is printed without its dot (ٮ), as on frames 036-073, and transcribed so; ه in its knotted initial form. The letters of a label are set as separate sorts, a narrow space apart (ٮ and ك in L02, 30 px; ا and د in L07, 37 px, the line over the ا only), and are transcribed together as one label, as on the earlier frames.

The figure, drawn, not set in type, below L11: a square with ا at the upper right corner, ٮ at the upper left, a hooked ح at the lower right and د at the lower left; ط at the middle of the upper side, ز at the middle of the left side, ه at the middle of the right side, and at the middle of the lower side a letter shaped like ح without a dot; ك at the centre, where the line from ط to the lower side crosses the line from ه to ز; the lines from ط to ز, from ز to the middle of the lower side, from there to ه and from ه to ط form the inner square. The ب of the figure has no dot.

L06: the point at the middle of the lower side is named twice with the ع-shaped sort, with the line above, as on frame 073, L16; the figure marks it with the letter shaped like ح without a dot, distinct from the hooked ح of the corner, which the text names ح in the labels حد, حك and اح (L01, L02, L05). See the critical note AK01-CN023.

L08: «، {ov:اه} تكسير مثلثين مثلهما», as printed, without «فى نفسه» after the label, where the clause before it has «ضلع اط فى نفسه» (L08) and L10 has «اه فى نفسه» (L10); the editors' note (١) reads the label here as اه multiplied by itself.

L04: the conjunction و before the labels هكط and اه stands 29 and 28 px (nearest approach above the baseline at 400 ppi) from them, about its distance from an alif inside a word (24 to 26 px, frame 070); it is transcribed joined, as the conjunction always is.

Where the gap lies between the distances inside a word and those between words, a word space is transcribed: قائمة وكذلك (L05; 17 between the ة and the conjunction و, at the boundary of the gaps after ة, 1 to 14 without a space and 16 or more with one); {ov:حد} أربعة (L01; 19 between the د and the alif, as تريد أن on frame 058, L04, 17).

The commas stand between spaces (gaps as the nearest approach of the ink at 400 ppi): after مثلثين, before the label اه (L08; 28 and 33), after نفسه, before the label اه (L10; 24 and 27). The note mark (١) stands 24 px after the label اه and 26 px before تكسير (L08). L11 ends with a full stop 25 px after صورته.

Plain alif where a hamza might be expected, as printed: الى (L03, L05; L06, twice); with hamza: أربعة (L01, L07), الأضلاع (L01), أن (L04, L07, L08, L10, L11), الأعظم (L07), أربع (L09, twice), أيضاً (L09), أخر (L10), أردنا (L11); on ي: قائمة (L05).
With tanwīn on the final alif: خطاً (L03), خطوطاً (L05), أيضاً (L09).
The final yā' is printed without dots: وهى (L01), الى (L03, L05, L06), على (L05), ثمانى (L06), الذى (L07, L10, L11), فى (L08, L09, L10, L11).
The print stretches جميع and ثمانى (L06, at length) with the elongation stroke; the stroke is not transcribed.
Note (١) of the editors reads the label اه of L08 as اه multiplied by itself; it is not reproduced.

critical_notes.class: labels of the text and of the figure disagree
critical_notes.evidence: The line names with ع the point at the middle of the lower side of the square, where the line from ط ends, joined by the new lines to ز and to ه. The figure on this page has no ع: at that point it has a letter shaped like ح without a dot, distinct from the hooked ح of the corner, the letter that the figures of frames 041, 042 and 050 have for ج; the text names the corner ح in the labels حد, حك and اح (L01, L02, L05). The same point is named with the same sort on frame 073, L16 (AK01-CN022).
critical_notes.confidence: high that the sort stands for the ج of the figure
critical_notes.impact: none on the mathematics: the labels only name the points of the figure
